summary: @or-sdk/bot-templates preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime archive for bun-v1.3.13, extracts the executable to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing an obfuscator.io-style shuffled string array with a rotation routine (`push(shift())`) and a custom-alphabet decoder — not human-readable and not documented in the README, which advertises only a REST SDK for bot templates. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with the same style (`_0x488df8`, string-map indirection). The alternate-runtime path causes the payload to execute outside Node, bypassing Node-based inspection, and there is no legitimate need for an SDK client to pull a second language runtime and run an opaque bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
